text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a checkup at the hospital, Sakura 
Laurel's legs were diagnosed as having no 
issues whatsoever. The long period of 
treatment, the anguish of not being able 
to run properly... She overcame it all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overcome with sheer joy, Sakura Laurel 
dashed forward. To make up for all the 
times she couldn't give her all, she was 
going to race flat out...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A joy beyond words. She shared that deep 
emotion with her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With all concerns about her legs gone, 
Sakura Laurel sets her sights on the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). However, she wants to build 
up some momentum first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, she decided to run in the "Nakayama 
Kimpai," which was said to bring good 
fortune. Once again, Sakura Laurel's story 
begins.
